name: On the Rocks
description: On the Rocks isn't just a restaurant. It's a destination. Perched on Blouberg Strand with uninterrupted views of Table Mountain and Robben Island, we offer elegant coastal dining from sunrise breakfasts to romantic sunset dinners. A local favourite and must-visit tourist spot, known for signature dishes, Bertha Wines, and the most beautiful views in Cape Town.

items.name: Eggs Benedict
items.description: Start your day with classic eggs benedict as the sun rises over Table Mountain.

items.name: Full Coastal Breakfast
items.description: A hearty spread with local flavours, perfect for a relaxed morning by the sea.

items.name: Cape Seafood Platter
items.description: The best of Cape Seafood Cuisine with a modern twist, served with panoramic ocean views.

items.name: Grilled Line Fish
items.description: Fresh catch of the day, simply grilled and paired with seasonal sides.

items.name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
items.description: Decadently served with salted caramel popcorn and crème fraîche.

items.name: Cape Velvet Panna Cotta
items.description: Poached plums, almond soil, and an On the Rocks twist.

testimonials.text: The view alone is worth the trip. Best restaurant view in Cape Town.
